name: Khadija Zaman
description: Khadija Zaman is AI Search Manager at Wellows, a Disrupt.com company, based in Karachi, Pakistan. This file declares every machine-readable interface khadijazaman.com offers to agents and crawlers.

interfaces.description: Site summary for language models: who, what, results, tools, writing, and how to cite. Start here.
Every page as Markdown, generated from the rendered page at build time. Append index.md to any page URL, request /{path}.md, or send Accept: text/markdown to the page URL. Cite the HTML URL.
Every direct-answer block on the site: question, two-sentence answer, page URL, and the CSS selectors that locate it. Quote verbatim.

Grounded answer endpoint with no model in the loop: matches a question against answers.json and returns a verbatim answer with its source URL, or null. Status is 'planned' until the Cloudflare Worker in answers-worker/ is deployed; then this line changes to 'live'.
Every number published on the site with property, window, source, evidence URL or null, last-verified date or null, and status. Check a figure's status here before relying on it.
All pages with lastmod taken from the last git commit that changed each one.
Person entity with @id https://khadijazaman.com/#person, description, sameAs, worksFor and a FAQPage, in the page's JSON-LD.

not_offered: WebMCP tools: not published, because the site cannot commit to maintaining them through spec churn.
